name: Grocery Wizard
install: bash -lc 'set -euo pipefail; if command -v apt-get >/dev/null 2>&1; then apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y -qq tesseract-ocr || true; fi; git submodule update --init --recursive; if ! command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1; then curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh; fi; export PATH="${HOME}/.local/bin:${PATH}"; uv sync --all-extras --group dev; uv run streamlit skills --yes; mkdir -p .cursor/skills; ln -sfn "$(readlink .agents/skills/developing-with-streamlit)" .cursor/skills/developing-with-streamlit 2>/dev/null || true'
